caption: The distribution of tokens and sentences across different domains in the SALT dataset is shown.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of sentences across various content categories within the SALT dataset, with the vertical axis labeled “Sentences (K)” indicating the count in thousands and using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 800, and the horizontal axis labeled “Categories” listing the domains in alphabetical order. Each category is represented by a single red bar whose height corresponds to the number of sentences, with the exact value labeled in blue text above each bar. The categories and their respective sentence counts are: Administrative (525K), Religion (50K), Non-fiction (190K), Fiction (35K), Law (23K), News (902K), Science (110K), and Blogs (2K). The bars are arranged in ascending order of sentence count from left to right, with the shortest bar for Blogs (2K) on the far right and the tallest bar for News (902K) positioned centrally. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their labeled values, and the chart does not include a legend or additional graphical elements.
